scripts.name: EMA Cross Signals
scripts.description: Two EMAs with a shaded gap and buy/sell markers where they cross.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: RSI Zones
scripts.description: RSI in its own pane; the line turns red when overbought and green when oversold.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Volume Spikes
scripts.description: Marks bars whose volume is far above its recent average.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: MACD Colors
scripts.description: MACD with a histogram colored by direction and whether it is growing or fading.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: EMA Cross Strategy
scripts.description: Goes long when the fast EMA crosses above the slow one and short when it crosses below, with a stop loss and a take profit on every trade. Results appear in the Strategy tester.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: RSI Mean Reversion
scripts.description: Buys when RSI climbs back above the oversold level and sells when it reaches the exit level.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Breakout + Trailing Stop
scripts.description: Buys a breakout above the highest high of the last N bars and rides it with a trailing stop.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Supertrend + Time Stop
scripts.description: Enters when Supertrend turns up and exits when it turns down or after a maximum number of bars. It uses strategy.onBar, which runs once per bar, for logic that depends on the open position.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Golden Cross
scripts.description: The classic long-term trend signal: be long while the 50-period SMA is above the 200, and step aside when it falls back below.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: MACD + Trend Filter
scripts.description: Trades MACD signal-line crosses, but only in the direction of the long-term trend: longs above the 200 EMA, shorts below it. Every trade has a stop loss and a take profit.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Bollinger Mean Reversion
scripts.description: Buys when price closes back above the lower Bollinger Band (a stretched move snapping back) and sells when it reaches the middle band.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Turtle Breakout
scripts.description: The Turtle traders' rules: buy a 20-bar high, sell a 10-bar low, and get out if price closes 2 ATRs below the entry.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: RSI(2) Pullback
scripts.description: A short-term pullback system: when price is above its 200 SMA (an uptrend), buy when the 2-period RSI is deeply oversold, and sell as soon as price closes above its 5 SMA.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Supertrend + ADX
scripts.description: Follows Supertrend flips both ways, but only opens a trade when ADX says the market is actually trending (above the threshold). A flip the other way closes the trade.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Parabolic SAR Flip
scripts.description: Always in the market: long while price is above the Parabolic SAR, short while it is below.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Stochastic Pullback
scripts.description: Buys when the Stochastic turns up from oversold while price is above its 200 EMA, and sells when the Stochastic reaches overbought (or on the stop loss).
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Squeeze Breakout
scripts.description: Volatility comes in waves: when the Bollinger Bands get as narrow as they have been in a while (a squeeze), trade the first close outside the bands, and ride it with a trailing stop.
scripts.author: Wickline

scripts.name: Range Breakout
scripts.description: Highest high and lowest low of the last N bars, with markers on breakouts.
scripts.author: Wickline
